changelog:
Pairing codes are going nine digits, and this phone is ready for both.

WHAT CHANGED

- Televisions will start showing nine-digit pairing codes, grouped in
  threes so they are easier to read out: 123 456 789. Type the digits
  as you always did - the spaces are only on the television's screen.
- During the changeover this phone accepts both lengths: six digits
  from a television that has not updated yet, nine from one that has.
  The scanner reads both too.
- The entry field now takes up to nine digits.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything else. Pairing still lasts until you end it, sending works
  the same way, and nothing you already use has moved.
